title: Picard 3.0
summary: Picard 3.0 is a major release of MusicBrainz's open-source music tagging application, introducing significant new features and improvements to the popular free music metadata organizer used by audiophiles and music enthusiasts worldwide.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of organizing and tagging large music collections with accurate, consistent metadata from the MusicBrainz database.
why_valuable: Provides a free, open-source solution for music lovers to properly identify and tag their audio files with comprehensive metadata from one of the largest music databases.
